text.tspan: Auto Scaling Group: keep the right number of healthy instances
ASG across 2 AZs · min 2 · desired 3 · max 6
scale out adds instances (up to max), scale in removes them (down to min).
Unhealthy instances are terminated and replaced.
• Simple / step: alarm → add or remove
• after a scaling action, a cooldown
• ASG is free: you pay for EC2
• health checks: EC2 status or ELB
